items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Oh, Johnny Russell, myself, Glyn Paque, me, Bob McRae and Kaiser Marshall.

ctx.x:
At that age you would, probably. You'd want to get
out...

Oh yeah. Well, that's why we left the band,
myself and Glyn Paque... We were (?)the last ones(?) in
Willie's band to leave. We had Mike Ray, Bob McRae and...
Bass Hill -- Bass Hill was in the band.
